proves.claim: clause 1: announceItemState writes a boardStateAnnouncement of the item into the file transport for each parent item that waits on it.

store.io-board-link-announce.writes-stat.why: Without it a parent waiting on a child item never learns the item moved.

proves.claim: clause 1: an item that no open parent item names writes nothing.

store.io-board-link-announce.skips-item-.why: Without it every child state change would be sent to parents that never asked.

proves.claim: clause 2: when the transport throws, announceItemState returns the failed delivery and the sealed envelope stays queued for resendPendingBoardStates.

store.io-board-link-announce.failed-deli.why: Without it a down transport would lose the announcement or undo the state move.
